purpose: Expand the scalar density of the committed universal vector-metric quadrature action through derivative-leading quartic order on the same frozen W=0 spacelike coefficient patch, canonically normalize the anisotropic scalar, derive exact longitudinal and transverse local derivative-interaction coefficient scales, compare them conditionally with the cutoff-dependent Cherenkov rate, and refuse to identify those engineering scales with a physical UV cutoff or an observational safety result.

primary_source_context.scope: Primary EFT context for derivative scalar interactions and the distinction between an infrared derivative Lagrangian and a controlled analytic UV completion. No positivity or UV-completion result from that paper is imported as a result for this Lorentz-breaking background.

Primary stationary scalar-Cherenkov rate context inherited from the predecessor. It motivates comparing a cutoff-dependent loss rate with an independently established EFT domain, but supplies no cutoff for the present action.

frozen_action_expansion.background: constant Einstein-frame Minkowski metric, Ubar^mu=(1,0,0,0), Wbar=0, varphi_bar=0, alpha>0, 0<s<1/2, and d_parallel phibar=Mpl a0 s/alpha
frozen_action_expansion.committed_scalar_density: L_phi=2 Lambda0^4 p(s_total)+K(s_total)(d_t pi)^2 at derivative-leading order, where p(s)=s^2/4+s/4+ln(1-2s)/8 and K(s)=2 alpha^2 s(1-s)/(1-2s)^2
frozen_action_expansion.quadratic_density: L2=K[(d_t pi)^2-(d_parallel pi)^2]-C|grad_perp pi|^2, C=alpha^2 s/(1-2s)
frozen_action_expansion.cubic_density: L3=(alpha^3/Lambda0^2)[2 r t/d^3-r u/d^2-2 r^3/(3d^3)], with d=1-2s, t=(d_t pi)^2, r=d_parallel pi, and u=|grad_perp pi|^2
frozen_action_expansion.scope: This is the exact derivative-leading fixed-metric, fixed-aether scalar expansion through fourth perturbative order on the declared constant patch. Undifferentiated varphi vertices from exp(-4varphi), metric, aether, matter, coefficient-gradient, constraint, loop, and higher-order interactions are excluded; therefore this is not the full fluctuation action.

canonicalization_contract.coordinate_map: X_parallel=x_parallel and X_perp=x_perp/c_perp, so d^2x_perp=c_perp^2 d^2Xperp
canonicalization_contract.canonical_field: chi=sqrt(Pprime) pi with Pprime=2 K c_perp^2=2C
canonicalization_contract.longitudinal_channel: unit on-shell wave covector in the isotropized coordinates with n_parallel=1
canonicalization_contract.transverse_channel: unit on-shell wave covector in the isotropized coordinates with n_parallel=0; each original-coordinate transverse derivative contributes 1/c_perp
canonicalization_contract.interpretation: The coordinate Jacobian and field normalization are part of every interaction coefficient. Omitting either, or omitting the committed W^2 coefficient K(s_total), gives a false interaction scale.

local_coefficient_scale_contract.longitudinal_cubic_coefficient: d3L=1/[3 sqrt(2) s^(3/2)(1-s)sqrt(1-2s)] and L3 contains d3L (d chi)^3/Lambda0^2 in the frozen longitudinal contraction
local_coefficient_scale_contract.transverse_cubic_coefficient: d3T=0 in the exactly transverse on-shell contraction
local_coefficient_scale_contract.engineering_scales: Lambda3L/Lambda0=d3L^-1/2, Lambda4L/Lambda0=d4L^-1/4, Lambda4T/Lambda0=d4T^-1/4, and LambdaCoeff is their minimum
local_coefficient_scale_contract.physical_ceiling_statement: LambdaCoeff is an exact local canonically normalized derivative-coefficient scale and at most an NDA-style candidate perturbativity ceiling. It is not a tree-unitarity bound, loop cutoff, strong-coupling theorem, UV completion, or physical emission cutoff.
local_coefficient_scale_contract.alpha_cancellation: All three nonzero dimensionless canonical channel coefficients are independent of alpha at fixed s.

endpoint_contract.low_gradient: As s->0, Lambda3L/Lambda0~18^(1/4)s^(3/4), Lambda4L/Lambda0~(8/5)^(1/4)s^(1/2), and Lambda4T/Lambda0~8^(1/4)s^(3/4); the transverse quartic channel forces LambdaCoeff/Lambda0 to zero.
endpoint_contract.finite_gradient_endpoint: For epsilon=1/2-s->0+, Lambda3L/Lambda0~(9/8)^(1/4)epsilon^(1/4), Lambda4L/Lambda0~(2/5)^(1/4)epsilon^(1/4), and Lambda4T/Lambda0~(4/3)^(1/4)epsilon^(1/4); the longitudinal quartic channel is the smallest asymptotically and LambdaCoeff/Lambda0 approaches zero.
endpoint_contract.interior_result: All three nonzero contracted coefficients and all three associated coefficient scales are finite and positive for every fixed 0<s<1/2.
endpoint_contract.uniformity_result: No strictly positive uniform lower bound for this local coefficient scale exists on the full open branch when either endpoint can be approached.
endpoint_contract.non_no_go_statement: Endpoint collapse of an NDA-style coefficient scale is not a proof that every finite interior background is strongly coupled or that no UV completion, regulated successor, or background restriction can exist.

cherenkov_comparison_contract.conditional_substitution: If a separately justified physical scalar emission cutoff obeyed OmegaUV<=LambdaCoeff and OmegaIR were negligible, the predecessor small-loss expression would be bounded by Fcoeff=Xi (1+v^2)^2(1-2s) lambdaCoeff^2/[32 pi s v V], with Xi=L E a0/Mpl and lambdaCoeff=LambdaCoeff/Lambda0.
cherenkov_comparison_contract.missing_inputs: Xi, s(x), direction, V, OmegaIR, formation length, compositeness, recoil, source coherence, a physical background solution, and the relation between LambdaCoeff and a physical cutoff are not established.
cherenkov_comparison_contract.adjudication: The derivative-leading coefficient expansion neither proves Cherenkov safety nor establishes an exclusion. It identifies an exact local coefficient ceiling that any future cutoff and survival calculation must justify rather than assume.
